title: What do I need to bring?
content:
€5 weekly club fee, your first night is free!
Besides that, bring a deck. We mainly play the 'Commander' variant.

title: I never played Magic before, can I still come?
content: Yes you can. We're happy to teach you how to play. You don't even need a deck, we always have spares.

title: What Magic formats do you play?
content: Commander is the most popular. We also play Pauper, Legacy, Vintage, Cube, and Booster Draft. We usually post about other formats on our social media if a non-Commander event is on.
